tasks.title: Establish the anonymous grant and pinned native transport feasibility
checks: Start only after independent architecture review, bounded assignment and new frozen run; use normal authorized anonymous browsing without cookies, bypass or alternate routes

For the ordinary-public amendment, independently review access-method.md and freeze a new bounded assignment; pass offline classifier/redaction tests before the fixed view-then-playback observation pair; preserve the two earlier UNKNOWN outcomes
Inspect the actual permitted response for the selected source/part/rendition using the reviewed method; distinguish preview/full/unknown and stop on restriction or ambiguous permission
Review exact native TLS certificate, redirect, public-header and container/codec behavior; perform bounded controlled runtime checks without changing the runtime or accessing target media natively

Record all-host HTTPS acceptance and native redirect/source-trust limits under ADR0007; do not require per-host approval; obtain independent gate review before TGT-002; failed or unknown inputs leave dependent tasks unstarted

tasks.title: Implement the paired opt-in input policy and bounded target probe
checks: Require independent TGT-001 grant/transport feasibility approval and exact shared-contract freeze; no code on unresolved access/TLS/format assumptions

Test strict bounded transient descriptors, permission/HTTPS-syntax/expiry, public-only headers, redaction and input copying at both controller and opener; existing fixture defaults/tests stay unchanged
Test grant/expiry/deadline enforcement, stale completion, loading/playing cancellation, complete ownership disposal, explicit fresh-input retry and failed process cleanup
Use a dedicated minimal target UI rather than changing fixture ui.View; no source URL in argv/environment/RPC/logs and no media capture

tasks.title: Review the candidate and collect one permitted target playback result
checks: Obtain independent exact-candidate transport/code/resource approval before the native target session; run affected unchanged fixture/native regression checks
Validate a fresh privately supplied descriptor for the actual granted anonymous source; run one bounded native invocation and preserve its first complete outcome, including restrictions/expiry
Record preview/full grant and per-capability results, public metadata/separate tracks where supplied, controls, 200ms cancellation and graceful cleanup without recording target media or locators
Do not assert broad full target access from preview, physical sync/rate from native state, M1 acceptance or default-player selection; retain Windows optional P2
go run ./cmd/dev check --race; obtain independent evidence disposition and preserve exact source/runtime identities
